# spydersoftidentity_role (Data Source)

Looks up a role by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "spydersoftidentity_role" "admin" {
  name = "admin"
}

output "admin_role_id" {
  value = data.spydersoftidentity_role.admin.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name. Unique, ignoring case. Renaming keeps the role id and its members.

### Read-Only

- `claims` (Attributes Set) Claims granted to every member of the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--claims))
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.

<a id="nestedatt--claims"></a>
### Nested Schema for `claims`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) Claim type. Must not contain "/".
- `value` (String) Claim value. Defaults to an empty string.
